name: Mount Longonot crater rim
why: Up a young volcano of the Rift Valley and all the way round its forest-filled crater, with Lake Naivasha below.
book: Kenya Wildlife Service fees at the gate. Matatu or taxi from Naivasha (45 min).
dangers: Loose ash on the steep slope.
Sun and no shade on the rim.
turnaround: If you reach the rim after 12:00, go back the way you came instead of round.

points.name: Longonot gate
points.note: The gate at the foot of the volcano.

points.name: Longonot summit
points.note: The 2,776 m top on the west side of the rim.
